name: Imagination
source:
You wake up in a weird place and in order to escape you must collect all 20 puzzle pieces,play mini games,interact with your friends and help them out! 

You may just want to stay there f̴̢͔̽̆̿̀̒̚͝o̶͎̩̪͙̰̬͙̗͗̂͠ré̷̳͎̭̔̀̆͆͋̿͝v̴̙͉̩͔̩͇͉̣̔̍͒̈̓͜ë̸̦̝̙̯̮̙̮̊͌̂ͅṛ̶́̆.
